sql: SELECT column_name,data_type,is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='genealogy_nodes' AND $1::text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT count(*)::int total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_public)::int public,count(*) FILTER(WHERE locked)::int locked,min(depth) min_depth,max(depth) max_depth,count(*) FILTER(WHERE parent_key IS NULL)::int roots,count(DISTINCT external_id)::int unique_ids,count(DISTINCT name)::int distinct_names,min(source_snapshot_at) first_snapshot,max(source_snapshot_at) last_snapshot,min(imported_at) first_import,max(imported_at) last_import FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1

SELECT depth,count(*)::int n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_public)::int public,count(*) FILTER(WHERE locked)::int locked,count(*) FILTER(WHERE taipa IS NOT NULL AND taipa<>0)::int nonzero_taipa FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 GROUP BY depth ORDER BY depth
SELECT taipa,count(*)::int n,min(depth) min_depth,max(depth) max_depth FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 GROUP BY taipa ORDER BY n DESC

WITH degrees AS(SELECT n.node_key,count(c.node_key)::int children FROM genealogy_nodes n LEFT JOIN genealogy_nodes c ON c.parent_key=n.node_key WHERE n.source=$1 GROUP BY n.node_key) SELECT children,count(*)::int n FROM degrees GROUP BY children ORDER BY children

SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.parent_key IS NOT NULL AND p.node_key IS NULL)::int missing_parents,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.parent_key=n.node_key)::int self_parents,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.node_key IS NOT NULL AND n.depth<>p.depth+1)::int bad_depth,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.node_key IS NOT NULL AND n.source<>p.source)::int cross_source,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.node_key IS NOT NULL AND n.external_parent_id<>p.external_id)::int parent_id_mismatch,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.is_public AND p.node_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT p.is_public)::int public_private_parent FROM genealogy_nodes n LEFT JOIN genealogy_nodes p ON p.node_key=n.parent_key WHERE n.source=$1

SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE name~'[0-9]')::int digits,count(*) FILTER(WHERE name~'(^|[^0-9])(1[0-9]{3}|20[0-2][0-9])([^0-9]|$)')::int year_token,count(*) FILTER(WHERE name~'[[:space:]]')::int whitespace,count(*) FILTER(WHERE name~*'(ұлы|улы|қызы|кызы|ович|евич|овна|евна)([[:space:][:punct:]]|$)')::int patronymic,count(*) FILTER(WHERE name~*'(^|[[:space:][:punct:]])(батыр|хан|би|сұлтан|султан|ақын|акын|жырау)([[:space:][:punct:]]|$)')::int title,count(*) FILTER(WHERE name~*'(жүз|жуз|тайпа|руы|роды|подрод|тармақ|тармак|атасы)')::int group_token,count(*) FILTER(WHERE name LIKE '[без имени #%')::int placeholder FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1

SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)::int reviewed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE publication_basis IS NOT NULL)::int basis,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT is_public AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL)::int private_reviewed FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1
SELECT external_id,name,depth,external_parent_id,publication_basis FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 AND is_public ORDER BY depth,external_id
SELECT external_id,name,external_parent_id,depth,taipa FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 AND depth<=1 ORDER BY depth,external_id

WITH RECURSIVE seeds AS (
 SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS s(external_id bigint,expected_name text,expected_parent_id bigint,expected_taipa bigint,type text,relationship_verified boolean)
), features AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.*,s.type AS verified_group_type,s.relationship_verified,
 n.name~*'(ұлы|улы|қызы|кызы|ович|евич|овна|евна)([[:space:][:punct:]]|$)' AS c_signal,
 (n.name~'[[:space:]]' AND n.name~*'(^|[[:space:][:punct:]])(батыр|хан|би|сұлтан|султан|ақын|акын|жырау)([[:space:][:punct:]]|$)') AS b_signal,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM genealogy_nodes child WHERE child.parent_key=n.node_key) AS has_children
 FROM genealogy_nodes n LEFT JOIN seeds s ON n.external_id=s.external_id AND n.name=s.expected_name AND n.external_parent_id=s.expected_parent_id AND n.taipa=s.expected_taipa
 WHERE n.source=$1
), classified AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN verified_group_type IS NOT NULL THEN 'A' WHEN c_signal THEN 'C' WHEN b_signal THEN 'B' ELSE 'D' END AS class FROM features
), eligible AS (
 SELECT node_key,parent_key,is_public FROM classified WHERE class='A' OR (external_id=1 AND parent_key IS NULL AND name='Қазақ')
), paths AS (
 SELECT node_key,parent_key,is_public FROM eligible WHERE parent_key IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT n.node_key,n.parent_key,n.is_public FROM eligible n JOIN paths p ON n.parent_key=p.node_key
)
SELECT
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY class) FROM(SELECT class,count(*)::int n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_public)::int public,count(*) FILTER(WHERE has_children)::int nonleaf,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT has_children)::int leaf,min(depth) min_depth,max(depth) max_depth FROM classified GROUP BY class)x) AS classes,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY depth,external_id) FROM(SELECT node_key,external_id,external_parent_id,name,depth,taipa,verified_group_type,relationship_verified,is_public FROM classified WHERE class='A')x) AS a_candidates,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM(SELECT c_signal,b_signal,count(*)::int n FROM classified GROUP BY c_signal,b_signal)x) AS signal_overlap,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('proposed_nodes_including_root',(SELECT count(*)::int FROM eligible),'full_candidate_path_nodes',count(*)::int,'currently_private_in_candidate_paths',count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT is_public)::int,'a_candidates',(SELECT count(*)::int FROM classified WHERE class='A'),'a_with_current_public_parent',(SELECT count(*)::int FROM classified n JOIN classified p ON p.node_key=n.parent_key WHERE n.class='A' AND p.is_public)) FROM paths) AS candidate_paths,
 (SELECT jsonb_build_object('corroborated_entity_type_records',count(*)::int,'corroborated_traditional_subgroup_edges',count(*) FILTER(WHERE relationship_verified)::int,'biological_parentage_verified',0) FROM classified WHERE class='A') AS e_overlay,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY depth,class) FROM(SELECT depth,class,count(*)::int n FROM classified GROUP BY depth,class)x) AS class_by_depth

sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.depth>1 AND n.taipa IS DISTINCT FROM p.taipa)::int parent_taipa_changes,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.taipa IS NULL)::int null_taipa,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.taipa=0)::int zero_taipa,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n.depth=1 AND n.taipa<>n.external_id)::int root_taipa_mismatch FROM genealogy_nodes n LEFT JOIN genealogy_nodes p ON p.node_key=n.parent_key WHERE n.source=$1
SELECT conname,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) definition FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.genealogy_nodes'::regclass AND $1::text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY conname
SELECT schemaname,tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname NOT IN('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND $1::text IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*)::int names_reused,sum(n)::int rows_with_reused_name,max(n)::int most_reused_name_count FROM(SELECT name,count(*) n FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 GROUP BY name HAVING count(*)>1)x
SELECT count(*)::int n FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 AND lower(trim(name)) IN('батыр','хан','би','сұлтан','султан','ақын','акын','жырау')
SELECT count(*)::int exact_lexical_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE depth>2)::int below_depth2 FROM genealogy_nodes WHERE source=$1 AND regexp_replace(lower(name),'[[:space:]]','','g')=ANY($2::text[])
